title: Deadline-driven phase pipeliner with tenant-aware backpressure
creator: Ava Chen
description: Introduce a deadline-aware pipelining scheduler that splits prefill and decode phases into micro-phases and applies tenant-aware backpressure to optimize latency SLOs while preserving throughput. The scheduler uses predictive phase-duration models and kernel-selection hints (sparse vs dense kernels, quantized paths) to steer requests to the most appropriate execution path, and provides speculative reservations and hedged decode launches for short-deadline tenants.
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler reduces P95 decode latency for P0 tenants by at least 15% on mixed workloads compared to baseline
Throughput loss for best-effort tenants under heavy load remains below 12%
Dashboard shows per-tenant latency and token-cost impact and exposes kernel routing decisions for each request
Canary rollout completes with no SLO breaches in dedicated test cluster for 72h
steps: Design: finalize ML model for phase-duration prediction and kernel hint feature set
Prototype: implement micro-phase pipelining actor with speculative reservations
Integrate: wire kernel hint metadata into routing/kernels selector
Testing: cluster-scale load tests with mixed tenant profiles and attention-sparsity signals
Observability: new tracing tags and console dashboard panels
Rollout: staged canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated rollback
risks_and_mitigation: Model mispredictions leading to unfair demotion: add conservative fallback and throttled learning windows
Speculative reservations increasing cost: limit concurrent speculative slots per tenant and timebox reservations
Kernel incompatible models: validate compatibility and fall back to compatible quantized variant
metrics: P50/P95/P99 latency per tenant (prefill and decode stages)
Token throughput and tokens/sec per GPU
Kernel switch rate and percent of requests routed to sparse kernels
Fairness score: ratio of P95 between P0 and P3 tenants
